iconField.description:
Defines from where to extract the icon to use for the marker.

**NOTE**: It should be part of `Font Awesome 6 Pro` icons.

overlayColorMappingConfig.description: Configuration for how to colorize the overlay of the marker.

badgesConfig.description:
Configuration for how to display badges on the marker.

**NOTE:** The configuration will be applicable to all the markers.

enable3DModels.description: Whenever to include 3D Models, this should be populated with the path to the model.

modelField.description: Model path to use for the 3D model. (Use when `enable3DModels` is set to `true`)

title: Definition on how to extract data to style {@link ReliabilityAsset} markers.
name: UiGeospatialAssetsMapMarkerStyleSpec
